source: Existing DF006 210 list.json B001 pages only, 2022-10-17..2025-10-08; 2 existing document.xml responses may corroborate original D1 events. No new authenticated requests of any kind.
preservation: Hash all baseline tracked files except explicitly allowed verify.py and CI integration, and all preexisting private data before analysis. Preserve DF006 original 70 spacing shortfalls, failed identity-parser attempt, original source snapshot and all original D1 ledgers. New outputs only in df007 namespaces.

event_definitions.OTHER: Disposal, retirement, trust amendment/extension/termination, completion/actual acquisitions are counted separately, never substituted for D1 or D2. Whitespace normalization only; remove explicit bracketed revision markers only to classify correction family, never to create a new entry. Unrecognized or combined titles remain ambiguous. D2 price outcomes must not be calculated.

receipt_identity: Validate 14-digit receipt, 8-digit corporate ID, source receipt date within requested slice; exact receipt duplicates deduplicate only when all source fields agree. Conflicting rows quarantine without choosing a favorable version. Retain original pages, hashes and acquisition time; per-row canonical hash and page lineage.
revisions: Original, correction, attachment addition, withdrawal/cancellation are distinct. Different receipts are not automatically independent events. Official supersedes linkage required for confirmed revision families. Without original documents: report unresolved receipt counts, same-company/date/family collision groups and company-level lower supply bound, not confirmed independent experiments. Same company repeated originals remain correlated.

evidence_tiers.1_TITLE: Exact frozen title-family matches by original/revision kind; no tradeability implication
evidence_tiers.2_SOURCE_IDENTIFIED: Nonconflicting receipt/corporate ID/date/family metadata and unambiguous source stock_code, with unresolved original-document and historical stock mapping explicitly flagged. This is an identified candidate, not historical identity approval.
evidence_tiers.3_QUALIFIED: Original document corroborates corporate identity and event kind, historical metadata stock linkage adequate for the declared limited exploratory track, complete RAW/ADJ stock and corresponding index window with21 prior sessions, positive liquidity, constant adjustment factor or action lineage, conservative next eligible session, resolved/quarantined prospective corrections. All DF006 PIT/execution caveats retained. New market-wide title rows alone cannot qualify.

historical_identity: Separate receipt-time corporate identity, API metadata stock code and current master. No present-day master backfill or fabricated delisting/code-change history. Multiple source codes for one corporate ID, code shared by multiple corporations, missing codes and non-Y/K labels flagged separately; chronology alone is not a corporate-action mapping. Delisting status remains UNKNOWN absent official historical evidence.
availability: No actual intraday publication time inferred from rcept_dt. Retain DATE_ONLY intervals and actual 2026 acquisition timestamps separately. For counts only, first observed regular index session strictly after receipt date, excluding DF005 documented delayed opens, is a modeled decision date. Calendar completeness and historical listing status remain unverified.
regimes: At modeled decision date use preceding21 observed corresponding index closes: last/first-1 <= -.05 is BEAR, >=.05 BULL, otherwise SIDEWAYS. Report missing index/market labels as UNKNOWN. Index regime proxy never proves historical stock tradeability.
cache_matching: Inventory existing cache manifests and date coverage. Reuse DF005 RAW/ADJ/index histories for49 nonempty stocks; original6 later-date caches cannot be extrapolated into earlier events. All missing or partial event windows stay in denominator. No interpolation, source-flag clearing or synthetic replacement.
research_entry_gate: No new D1 economics in DF007. Supply is worth preparing a follow-up only if >=30 nonconflicting original title candidates, >=10 corporate IDs, >=20 modeled decision dates and >=5 BEAR candidates; these are supply counts, never qualified/OOS evidence. A shortage stops D1 expansion and shifts planning priority to B ORB without starting B economics. Adequate supply but missing documents/historical mapping/prices => EVENT_DATA_DEPENDENCY_PENDING. EVENT_UNIVERSE_EXPANSION_FEASIBLE requires >=30 tier3 original families/10 companies/20 dates/5bear; fewer => not certified feasible.
D2: D2_TREASURY_TRUST_CONTRACT is a distinct economic hypothesis of delayed response to an original acquisition trust-contract decision. Count supply only; amendments, extensions, termination and actual acquisitions separate. No entry/exit rule, price outcome or optimization here. Separate remotely frozen D2 protocol and adequate evidence required before later economics.
risk_audit: Independently read unchanged DF006 263020 BASE/STRESS/PARTIAL ledgers and inputs. Recompute target .25, pretrade NAV, limit, desired floor(target*NAV/limit), submitted/fill quantities, postfill marked weight including fees, subsequent cash/NAV/close weights and no-buy drift. Reconcile all money and quantity. ReferencePortfolio enforces signal identity/cash/order mechanics, not central account ongoing concentration policy. v1.2 section5.2 and section3.4 explicitly leave LIVE numerical limits unapproved. Distinguish .25 research target from a separately specified persistent marked exposure cap; preserve old report's measured exceedance without promoting it to an approved LIVE violation.
risk_reduction: Audit only; no alternative return curve is required or optimized. Specify a separate future research policy: after completed-close weight>.25, next eligible decision requests reduction using actual integer inventory, current usable NAV/price, cash and participation constraints; no future open known at decision, no guaranteed execution. Keep submitted/filled/remaining/expired/rejected/HOLD separate. Gap/halt/one-share residual can prevent restoring cap. Persistent intraday cap cannot be proved with daily closes. No new version of D1 or old ledger rewrite.
followup_plan: If supply gate passes, enumerate every missing original receipt/document, every stock code and union of bounded event windows: at least21 warmup sessions, model5-calendar-day holding plus2 observed followup sessions, RAW+ADJ and matched indices. Conservative calendar-day envelopes [receipt-90days,receipt+21days], clipped to needed source coverage and segregated when followup beyond approved disclosure interval. Estimate <=100 rows/page, failed/retry-inclusive worst case2 per planned request, PAPER auth<=2 only as a proposal. Include document verification and historical identity/halt/action unknowns, cache reuse and actual provider availability uncertainty. No unused DF005/006 allowance is reused. No authentication without a new exact-scope approval.
